title: System embree causes crash in 3D occlusion culling demo
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in `4.8.dev.custom_build.af481fd22`, `4.7.2.stable.voidlinux`
- Not reproducible in `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`
- Has to do with the build flag `builtin_embree`

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable unknown - Void #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Aug 10 23:38:14 UTC 2026 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics - AMD Ryzen 7 7840U w/ Radeon  780M Graphics (16 threads) - 30.66 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When opening a project with occlusion culling either with or without editor causes a crash in embree.
This only occurs when compiled against a system embree and on a system with AVX512 support.

### Steps to reproduce

Download `occlusion_culling_mesh_lod` demo.

Not sure if 100% required:
```
rm -rf .godot
rm -rf ~/.local/share/godot
```

Try to open the editor.

```
godot -e 
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Open latest `occlusion_culling_mesh_lod` demo from [Godot demos](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/releases/tag/4.7-6ad6167).
